scope: Independent reconstruction of raw calls, source/candidate custody, budgets, phase barriers, normalization, file/canonical hashes, assembly metadata and index/report cells. No writes, actors, retests or semantic grading.
limits: Old fidelity grades do not qualify new source-bound models.
New semantic assessment and planned comparison tests remain unperformed.
Actor times are summed intervals, not concurrent wall time or accepted-result cost.
Cache counters and tokens do not establish billing; reasoning is not added to output twice.
One generation per cell and changing subject coordinates do not establish general performance effects.
